subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should maintainers keep this draft as the combined Telegram proof target until a successful baseline/candidate artifact exists, or close it in favor of the split PRs now?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the only live proof run skipped both sides; deciding whether scheduler-level tests are enough or a Telegram Desktop proof is mandatory is a maintainer proof-sufficiency call.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep this draft open and non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, logs, or live output show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Scheduler Proof Only
options.body: Treat the mocked scheduler and harness tests as enough for the split PRs and close this stack after recording that live Telegram proof is not required.

options.title: Merge Combined Stack
options.body: Intentionally merge the stack as one boundary and accept the combined delivery and proof-automation risk instead of preserving the split PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open and non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, logs, or live output show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history carries the proof-runner and media scheduler files, making this the best available routing candidate for the proof-harness decision.
